readerCopy.body: Visibility can become easier to tolerate when difficult history does not have to be erased before current ability is allowed to be recognized. When the Sun sextiles Chiron, identity and sensitivity cooperate, allowing work, leadership, appearance, or experience to be seen without turning the older embarrassment or setback into the only story that matters. Recognition can include evidence of learning rather than requiring a flawless history. The present becomes easier to inhabit when the old mistake is no longer the price of every new exposure.
